about_the_game:
About RIFTSTORM

Storms are coming.

A small and insignificant ball amidst a cosmos of myth, legend, and unrelenting horrors, our Earth is under constant threat from that which defies human understanding. Rifts from other worlds and dimensions threaten to consume us. Monsters from within and without transcend human comprehension. While the might of mankind may pale in comparison, immeasurable power awaits those who weave the raw energies of the rift.

In RIFTSTORM, you will take on the role of a Weaver, an elite operative tasked with the closure of Rifts and the containment of mythic threats.

For those who seek the dark and unknowable truths of this world; there are rules to abide by: those of the Mythic Protocol.

Welcome to the Protocol

The great secret societies all bend to the Mythic Protocol, an organization that seeks out, contains, and codifies the vastness of the mythic unknown. Within the shadow of this secretive organization, you will operate, protecting the world from threats few know of and fewer still understand.

Deploy, Loot, Repeat

Collect an arsenal of weapons imbued with the supernatural technologies of secret societies. Find or build the perfect weapons for your Weavers and adapt their playstyles to any mythic challenge you may face in the field.

Follow the Protocols, Contain the Threats

Mythics lurk in the dark corners of our world, taking on countless forms. Each species presents its own distinct challenges and dangers, and to face them, one must understand the Protocols that safeguard our world.

Weave Powerful Abilities

Choose from a growing roster of Weavers— elite operatives who wield the power to close Rifts. Recruited from across the Mythic Protocol, every Weaver comes with unique skills and playstyles that reflect each unit within the organization.

Adapt and Evolve Your Weavers

Make each Weaver your own. Reshape and fine-tune your Weavers’ skills and abilities through our unique Periapts.

No Two Missions are Alike

Combine over 100 different lythogram power-ups and discover different combinations with each mission. Lythograms apply wide-ranging boosts and modifiers to your Weavers, ensuring no shortage of playstyles and synergies.

Operate Across the Globe with Friends

More than just a reactionary force, deploy alone or with up to two friends— chasing Rifts and Mythics as you uncover mysteries of the unknown. Every mission objective has a larger impact on the world and your place in it.

  • Processor: Intel core i3 gen 8
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050

short_description: Storms are coming, and there are rules you must follow. RIFTSTORM is co-op looter-shooter set in a world of myth and secret societies where you can play solo or co-op in a party of three.

English*, French, German, Arabic, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support
